beats.say: Russia lost 1,600 crore rupees on the Moon. India spent less than half, and you won't guess what happened.
August 2023. Russia's Luna-25 heads for the Moon's south pole.
lines: Russia, to the Moon's south pole

beats.say: बीस अगस्त को, वो चाँद पर crash हो गया।
beats.cap: On 20 August, it crashed into the Moon.

beats.say: तीन दिन बाद, भारत की बारी। Chandrayaan-3, about 615 crore rupees.
beats.cap: Three days later, India's turn. Chandrayaan-3, about 615 crore rupees.

beats.say: On 23 August, it landed near the south pole. A first for anyone.
lines: the first landing in that region

beats.say: The film Interstellar cost 165 million dollars. Chandrayaan-3? About 74.
lines: film budget, not adjusted for inflation

beats.say: यानी असली mission, film से आधे से भी सस्ता।
beats.cap: So the real mission cost less than half the film.
lines: the price of a space film

beats.say: Split across 140 crore Indians, that's about four rupees forty each. Less than a cup of chai.
lines: less than a cup of chai

beats.say: Send this to the friend who says space is a waste of money. One space money story every week. Follow for number two.
lines: Send to the friend who says space is a waste
